en: Sukhasahagataduka (The Pair on Being Accompanied by Pleasure)
Dependent on a state not accompanied by pleasure, a state not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by neither-pain-nor-pleasure, a state not accompanied by neither-pain-nor-pleasure arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state both not accompanied by pleasure and not accompanied by neither-pain-nor-pleasure, a state not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are six; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are nine.
